description: This file defines the EnableRoleCommandHandler class, which handles commands to enable roles in the system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses RoleWritePlatformService to perform the enabling operation.

classes.name: EnableRoleCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that processes 'ENABLE' commands for roles, enabling a role via RoleWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to enable a role by invoking the writePlatformService's enableRole method.

methods.name: EnableRoleCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the RoleWritePlatformService dependency via Spring's @Autowired.
